text: Teaching Objectives The major trains enroll students to produce quality engineers of computer software and hardware in design, development and applications. By study, students can master the fundamental theories and basic techniques of computer software and hardware; eligible to analysis, design and develop software; eligible to use, develop and maintain hardware; eligible to operate and maintain computer networks. Computer Science and Technology consists of three research directions: 1、 Computer Architecture: Embedded system design and testing technique, Network engineering and information system 2、 Computer Software and Theory: Software engineering design, development and integration, System software and database, Data mining, Knowledge-based engineering, Artificial intelligence. 3、 Computer Applied Technology: Multi-media technology, Computer network architecture, Network and information security. Fees Tuition: RMB 29,400 per year (2.5-year system) Other fees: Application: 135USD Resident permit: RMB 800 per year Photos: RMB 40 Medical checkup: RMB 400 Room deposit: RMB 300 Insurance: RMB 600 per year Student card: RMB 10 Books: Depending on courses Degree Awarded Master 's degree of Engineering.
